technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring for Apache Kafka to implement Kafka-based data pipelines in XD.
Use Spring Batch and Spring Integration for Sqoop-based batch processing samples.

assumptions: Existing Spring XD infrastructure and build environment are available.
Kafka, Sqoop, Storm, and Spark clusters are accessible for testing.
Documentation and sample code templates already exist for reference.
All required dependencies are resolvable via standard Maven/Gradle repositories.
Development team is familiar with Spring ecosystem and related technologies.

activities.activity_description: Build a data pipeline using Kafka as a message bus in XD, including log aggregation and lambda architecture examples.
Create a batch sample using Sqoop for JDBC to HDFS and HDFS to JDBC use cases.
Modify Gradle scripts to remove documentation generation tasks and link rewriting.
Provide a comparison of Storm examples in Spring XD for field engineers.
Provide a comparison of Spark Streaming examples in Spring XD for field engineers.
Port the Smart Grid demo from s1-2014 into the Spring XD samples repository.
Develop an example demonstrating JDBC to HDFS data movement.
